The easier way to do this: the web checklist (steps, notes, a report Claude can read). Ask Claude for its link.
How to put the new version on a copy: [DEPLOY.md](https://github.com/jskeller29/Parent-coordinator-sheet/blob/Test-Version/DEPLOY.md), sections 1 to 3.
Test files: [test-data](https://github.com/jskeller29/Parent-coordinator-sheet/tree/Test-Version/test-data) (its README says what each one should show).
Something fails? Write it as a comment on this issue: the step, what you saw, a screenshot, and any red error from Extensions → Apps Script → **Executions**.
Checks marked _(optional)_ can wait, and _(try to break it)_ ones are extra. Do the other 63 (the essentials) before any school gets this version. Round 3: **New** and **Fixed, re-test** mark what changed since the last round.

## Part 1: Before you start
Four rules for test copies, and this version on your copies. Making the copies isn't tested here.

### Before you start
_Four rules for every test copy, then this version on your copies._
- [ ] **0.1 One Google account in this browser.** Use a browser window signed in to only your school Google account (a private window where you sign in once works too). **You should see:** Only one account shows when you click your picture at the top right of Google Sheets. _Why: Several accounts in one browser can make the 🚀 App Menu slow or missing._ _Last time: Works_
- [ ] **0.2 Phone sync stays off on test copies.** Never Save ⚙️ Settings → Contacts & sync → "Sync contacts to Google Contacts every night" turned on, on a test copy. The Phone sync stage (6.1 to 6.3, from a second Google account) is the one exception. A new copy starts with it off, so there is nothing to turn off: just look once after each copy's Initial Setup. (1.26 turns it on to see the new warning, then off again before Save.) **You should see:** The switch is off when you open ⚙️ Settings on a test copy. _Why: A test copy with it on would put its families into the "School Directory" label of YOUR Google Contacts every night at 10 PM._ _Last time: Works_
- [ ] **0.3 Never bring over from your live sheet.** When a test asks you to bring over last year's tracker, pick a test copy, never your live sheet. **You should see:** Your live sheet never asks "Keep this tracker paused?". _Why: Bringing a tracker over pauses that tracker's 10 PM rebuild. If it happens to your live sheet: open it and answer No._ _Last time: Works_
- [ ] **0.4 The test files.** Download "PC Tracker test data.zip" again from the test-data folder on GitHub and unzip it: it has two new files, 2c and 5e. **You should see:** A folder with 1 - Student Data (ATS), 2 - Parent Square (and 2b, 2c), 3 - NYCSA (and 3b), 4 - Site and Class, and five 5 - Your Lists files (5a to 5e). _Last time: Works_
- [ ] **0.5 This version on your copies.** **New.** On the sheet you make your test copies from (your way: your main sheet), paste this version from Test-Version (DEPLOY.md, "This update (2026-11-23)"): the scripts Core, Build, Edits, Menus, Input Data, Contacts Sync, Regenerate and z_MINE; the pages InputDataSidebar, ManageOverridesDialog, NewStudentDialog, SettingsDialog, ProgressSidebar, YourListsSidebar; and the NEW page FindFamily. Save, then reload. 🚀 App Menu → 🏗️ Build Sheets Only once. It writes the Method 2 list on the hidden Backend tab (column CQ) and adds the light red Method color. The one change by hand (DEPLOY.md step 10): Contact Log → click a cell in Method 2 (column K) → Data → Data validation → Dropdown (from a range) ='Backend'!$CQ$3:$CQ, Advanced options → Show a warning. Done. Person Spoke With not on ='Backend'!$CF2:$CO2 yet? Step 9 too. Then make your two test copies your usual way (🐞 Debug → 📦 Make Release Copies: the EXAMPLE is your fake-data copy, the BLANK your test template). In both: delete the z_ files and paste App Scripts (General).Json. **You should see:** Saving shows no red error. In both copies, the Contact Log's Method 2 dropdown lists Call, Text, Email, Voicemail, Meeting, In School (the fake-data copy also has the ones its rows use, like Intake). The light red Method color needed nothing by hand. _Why: A copy gets the code and the dropdowns of the sheet it is made from, so the dropdown is set once, before the copies._ _New: Round 3: this one step instead of part 1's set-up checks (you said you don't need to test making the copies)._

## Part 2: Test with fake data
The main test: what a new user sees, what's new, a returning school and day to day. Fake students and fake exports, so nothing real can be hurt and every answer is known.

Its first line (pale yellow) says what to do if 🚀 App Menu doesn't show: wait up to a minute, then reload. Then the 6 permissions Google will ask for. A note at the bottom right points to 🚀 App Menu → 🚨 Initial Setup. The menu shows. - [ ] **8.7 Pilot.** Give 1 or 2 friendly schools the BLANK copy's /copy link and let them use it for a week or two. **You should see:** Nothing they report is left unfixed.
- [ ] **8.8 The Version Tracker row.** Add a row: A = the version date, D "Blank Copy" = the BLANK's /copy link, E "Example" = the EXAMPLE's link, F "Document" = the User Guide (when it changed). **You should see:** Every school's tracker now offers "New Version Available".
- [ ] **8.9 Links.** _(optional)_ 🐞 Debug → 🔗 My Links. Then 📖 Open User Guide. **You should see:** Every link from the 📌 YOUR LINKS box, and "Version Tracker, column D/E/F" with each link. "See an example tracker" shows in 📖 Open User Guide.
- [ ] **8.10 The User Guide Doc.** _(optional)_ Ask Claude for the list of what changed in docs/USER_GUIDE.md, and make those changes in the Google Doc (this version: Find a Family, Phone numbers to check, the list purpose, Tell me what changed, the phone sync warning, Method 2). **You should see:** The Google Doc matches this version.
- [ ] **8.11 Merge into main.** _(optional)_ Ask Claude to merge Test-Version into main. **You should see:** main is the version schools have.
- [ ] **8.12 Clean up the test copies.** Move each test copy to the trash: the fake-data copy, the test template and the copies made from it, "PC Tracker - Last year (test)", the second account's copy, and a copy of your main sheet if you made one for part 3. **You should see:** Nothing else to do: a tracker in the trash skips its 10 PM rebuild by itself. _Why: Every copy that ran Initial Setup has its own 10 PM rebuild under your account, and Google can keep running a trashed sheet's script until the trash is emptied. This version checks for the trash, so trashing is enough._

## Part 5: Try to break it
Things a busy or curious person might do. None of these should lose data or leave the sheet stuck. Shown with Show → Try to break it. Add your own tests at the end.

### 9. Things that might break it
_The fake-data copy (or a fresh copy of the test template where it says so). Never your live sheet. Mark each one Works (nothing broke) or Problem, and write what happened._
- [ ] **9.1 Click around fast in Input Data Mode.** _(try to break it)_ 📥 Input Data Mode → Start. Click Parent Square, NYCSA, Site / Class and Student Data in the bar as fast as you can, a few times. **You should see:** It ends on the last step you clicked, with one yellow tab. No error, no "Sheet … not found".
- [ ] **9.2 Close the panel half way through a move.** _(try to break it)_ Upload the Student Data file and close the side panel (its X) right away. Wait 20 seconds, then 🚀 App Menu → 📥 Input Data Mode. **You should see:** The panel comes back on the step after Student Data (the file went in), or on Student Data with nothing half written. Raw Data's student rows are complete.
- [ ] **9.3 Two browser tabs on the same sheet.** _(try to break it)_ Open the same sheet in a second browser tab. Start 📥 Input Data Mode in both, and upload a file in one. **You should see:** Both panels end on the same step. Only one Input Data Mode tab. Exiting in one brings your tabs back.
- [ ] **9.4 Show a hidden tab while Input Data Mode is on.** _(try to break it)_ While Input Data Mode is on: View → Hidden sheets → Contact Log. Stay on the yellow tab for 15 seconds. **You should see:** The Contact Log is hidden again within about 10 seconds. When you exit, your usual tabs come back.
- [ ] **9.5 Delete Input Data Mode's own tab.** _(try to break it)_ While Input Data Mode is on, go to another tab (View → Hidden sheets), then right-click the yellow tab → Delete. **You should see:** The panel makes a new yellow tab at its next check, or says to reload the page. After a reload it goes on where you were.
- [ ] **9.6 Settings in the middle of Input Data Mode.** _(try to break it)_ While Input Data Mode is on: 🚀 App Menu → ⚙️ Settings → Save. **You should see:** Within about 10 seconds the other tabs are hidden again. Exit brings them back.
- [ ] **9.7 Build twice at once.** _(try to break it)_ 🚀 App Menu → 🏗️ Build Sheets Only, and as soon as the panel opens, the same menu item again. **You should see:** One build runs; the other says another build is running. Nothing is half built.
- [ ] **9.8 Input Data Mode during a build.** _(try to break it)_ Start 🏗️ Build Sheets Only, then right away 📥 Input Data Mode. **You should see:** The panel waits ("Waiting for the sheet…") if it must, then opens. No "Lock timeout". The tabs are hidden once it is on.
- [ ] **9.9 The wrong file at every step.** _(try to break it)_ In Input Data Mode upload: a Your Lists file at Student Data, the Student Data file at NYCSA, and any picture or PDF renamed to .csv. **You should see:** A clear message each time ("This looks like … data" or "couldn't be read"), nothing moved to Raw Data.
- [ ] **9.10 Delete several Contact Log rows at once.** _(try to break it)_ Select Contact Log rows 3 to 6 (their numbers) → Delete rows. Then the Table's own delete on two rows. **You should see:** The rows go. Person Spoke With still lists each row's own guardians. The Communications box under END drops the deleted notes. The thick line above the box stays.
- [ ] **9.11 Insert rows in the middle of the Contact Log.** _(try to break it)_ Right-click a row number in the middle → Insert 5 rows above. Type a contact into one of the new rows. **You should see:** The new row fills in (student, OSIS, date…); its Person Spoke With lists its own guardians; END is still below the last row.
- [ ] **9.12 Copy a whole row.** _(try to break it)_ Copy a whole Contact Log row (its row number) and paste it over an empty row above END. **You should see:** The pasted row keeps its student; the dropdowns on every row still work (no #REF!).
- [ ] **9.13 Sort the Contact Log.** _(try to break it)_ Click a cell in the Contact Log → Data → Sort range by Date, newest first. Then sort it back. **You should see:** Each row keeps its own student, OSIS and notes; Person Spoke With follows each row.
- [ ] **9.14 Rename a list's tab by hand.** _(try to break it)_ Right-click a Your Lists tab (🚌 Bus Routes) → Rename → "Bus". Then 📥 Input Data Mode → Your Lists, and build. **You should see:** The list still shows on the Your Lists step and the build still adds its column.
- [ ] **9.15 Initial Setup twice, or reload in the middle.** _(try to break it)_ On a fresh copy of the test template: Initial Setup, and while the bar is moving reload the page. Then Initial Setup again. **You should see:** The second setup finishes normally. One 10 PM job (Extensions → Apps Script → Triggers shows one nightlyMasterSync).
- [ ] **9.16 A very long note.** _(try to break it)_ Paste a very long text (a few pages) into a Contact Log row's notes column. **You should see:** The row saves; Combined Contact Tracking and the Communications box still show the student's notes.
- [ ] **9.17 Tick nothing, then Start.** _(try to break it)_ 📥 Input Data Mode: untick every card on the start page and try Start. Then tick one and click a step in the bar that isn't ticked. **You should see:** Start is grey ("Tick what to update"). The bar click opens that step; afterwards the ticked one still comes. No error.
- [ ] **9.18 Add a parent, then take it back.** _(try to break it)_ 👤 Student Overrides: add a parent from Parents to add, let the build run, then Delete that change under Your changes. **You should see:** After the next build the parent is back under Parents to add, and the student has only the ATS guardians again.
- [ ] **9.19 Find a Family during a build.** _(try to break it)_ Start 🏗️ Build Sheets Only, then right away 🔍 Find a Family and search a family. **You should see:** It opens and finds the family, or says something went wrong; nothing in the sheet changes. Opened again after the build, everything is there.
- [ ] **9.20 ATS catches up with a saved number.** _(try to break it)_ After 2.1 (Homer's 2nd number saved): in Raw Data, in Bart Simpson's row, set Guardian Phone Number 1 (column V) to 1115550101. 🏗️ Build Sheets Only, then open 🗂️ Student Overrides. **You should see:** Bart's part of the saved number is gone (ATS has it now); Lisa's stays until her row has it too. No error.
- [ ] **9.21 Phone sync on, then close without saving.** _(try to break it)_ ⚙️ Settings → turn on phone sync → "I understand, turn it on" → close Settings with its X (no Save). Open ⚙️ Settings again. **You should see:** Phone sync is still off: nothing was saved.
- [ ] **9.22 Delete a list you watch.** _(try to break it)_ 📥 Input Data Mode → Your Lists → 🗑️ on a list with "Tell me what changed" → Finish → Build my sheets. **You should see:** The build finishes, with no "what changed" line for the deleted list.
- [ ] **9.23 Paste new version, then close the panel.** _(try to break it)_ 📥 Input Data Mode → Your Lists → Paste new version on a list. Close the side panel with its X. 🚀 App Menu → 🏗️ Build Sheets Only. Then 🚀 App Menu → 📥 Input Data Mode → Finish Input Data Mode. **You should see:** The build keeps the list's column in the Student List as it was. After Finish the list's tab has its rows again, and View → Hidden sheets has no "(old version)" tab.
